title: MoDL
paper_title: MoDL: Model-Based Deep Learning Architecture for Inverse Problems
core_mech: 共享 CNN prior 与可微共轭梯度 data-consistency 子问题交替展开。
core_mech_en: Alternates a weight-shared multi-layer CNN denoiser prior D_θ with a differentiable numerical Conjugate Gradient (CG) solver enforcing exact data consistency (A*A + λI)^{-1}.
input_desc: 测量 y、已知前向算子 A 与伴随 A*
input_en: Undersampled multi-coil k-space measurements b, forward operator A (incorporating coil maps + FFT + mask), and adjoint A*
output_desc: K 次共享权重迭代后的重建 x_hat
output_en: Reconstructed MRI image x_K after K weight-shared alternating minimization stages

source.title: MoDL

adapter.name: MoDL
adapter.mechanism: One shared residual CNN alternates with differentiable CG solves of (A* A + lambda I)x=A*y+lambda D(x).
limitations: Eight CG iterations approximate each solve; three unrolls and synthetic Cartesian two-coil data.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
